checklist.item: No ticket numbers (HFD-412, HFD-440 and so on)
checklist.evidence: The client report has no ticket numbers. They show up only in the author-only 'Left out of the report' section, listed as removed: "All ticket numbers (HFD-412, 398, 431, 440)."

checklist.item: No unexplained jargon: UAT, CDC, DAG, SCD2, RLS, dbt, P1, gold models, marts
checklist.evidence: Each term is rewritten in plain language, e.g. UAT → "User testing starts", SCD2 → "Customer and product history tracking... how details have changed over time", RLS → "region-level access... each regional manager sees only their own region's data", P1 → "(blocker)".

checklist.item: A client executive could understand every line without asking what it means
checklist.evidence: Every line is plain business language, e.g. "Changes from your ERP system now sync automatically and reliably" and "about 1.5% off finance's month-end number... a difference in when returns are counted". The only technical terms left (ERP, Power BI, code freeze) belong to the client or are standard business vocabulary.
